The issuer appears to have a strong balance sheet and liquidity profile, with a 1.71 current ratio, nearly 48% equity funding of assets, and sizable retained earnings. Profitability is also robust given EBIT of 7,508M on 18,015M of revenue, supporting an upper-medium-grade assessment, though the absolute liability load keeps it short of the highest categories.

DECISION: A+
